result.summary: Several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a misspelled search placeholder, and a promo card that appears cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped so the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal list peeks enough of the next card or wrap/truncate names with an ellipsis so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and other details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so the last card is fully visible above the tab bar, or allow the list to scroll fully.

issues.description: Search placeholder is misspelled as 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right, showing only a sliver of the next filter.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/peek or ensure the last visible chip isn't clipped so users can tell the list is scrollable.
